kbd.what: Kbd. A physical keyboard legend with machined keycap depth, system monospace type, and finite press motion

keyframe-scrub-stack.what: Keyframe Scrub Stack. A keyframe-sequenced stack of cards with offset timing and easing presets.

kinetic-center-build.what: Kinetic Center Build. A centered phrase builder where words push into place until the line locks.

label.what: Label. A calm form label with compact requirement metadata for video UI scenes

landing-code-showcase.what: Landing Code Showcase. A product hero where code output becomes a live preview card.

light-leak.what: Light Leak. Shader transition with cinematic light leak overlay

line-by-line-slide.what: Line-by-Line Slide. Each line enters from the left with staggered slide and exits to the right.

logo-outro.what: Logo Outro. Cinematic logo reveal with piece-by-piece assembly, glow bloom, tagline fade-in, and URL pill

logo-sting.group: brand, impact, logo, motion-primitive, reveal, sting

logo-wall.what: Logo Wall. A trusted-by wall of placeholder lettermark logos that fades and scales into place with a deterministic per-cell stagger.

lt-mask-reveal.what: Lower Third, Mask Reveal. Cardless lower third: an accent sweep crosses and clip-path-reveals a heavy name, role fades up; for footage

lt-soft-pill.what: Lower Third, Soft Pill. Rounded white pill lower third for podcasts/interviews: status dot, name + role, scale-pop entrance

lt-stack-bars.what: Lower Third, Stack Bars. Two stacked bars: a dark name bar wipes from the left, an accent role bar wipes from the right

macos-notification.what: macOS Notification. Animated macOS-style notification banner with app icon and message

macos-tahoe-liquid-glass.what: macOS Tahoe Liquid Glass Desktop. 3D MacBook with a macOS Tahoe-style desktop, glass menu bar, Finder window, dock, and cinematic device camera move.

mask-reveal-up.what: Mask Reveal Up. Lines reveal upward through a tight mask with compact stagger.

masked-slide-reveal.what: Masked Slide Reveal. Words slide up out of an invisible horizontal mask one after another.

match-cut.avoid_when: Avoid it when a crossfade is required, because scene A becomes invisible and scene B visible at the same timeline instant.

matrix-decode.what: Matrix Decode. Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.

menu-morph.what: Menu Morph. A transitions.dev-inspired hamburger and plus-menu morph primitive for compact action menus

mesh-gradient-bg.what: Mesh Gradient Background. A render-safe mesh gradient using animated radial layers.

micro-transitions.group: microinteraction, motion-primitive, transition, transition-primitive, transitions-dev-port, ui

modal-morph.group: demonstrate, deterministic, experiment, flip, modal, motion-primitive, shared-element, structure
modal-morph.what: Modal Morph. morph-swap.group: bridge, condense, holdable, morph, reshape, slots, swap, transition, transitions

morph-text.group: animation, gooey, kinetic, morph, text, text-effect, typography

multi-device-splay.group: demonstrate, desktop, device, motion-primitive, phone, splay, tablet, ui-props

native-select.what: Native Select. A compact native select with a clear label, technical value, and focus state

news-ticker.what: News Ticker. Premium broadcast-style lower-third ticker with live label, headline ribbon, and scrolling news crawl.

north-korea-locked-down.what: North Korea Locked Down. Realistic map zoom into North Korea with a red scribble circle, locked-down pop-up label, and reddish editorial wash.

notification-stack.variables: titles:string="Build queued,Checks passed,Deploy live", bodies:string="Pipeline started for main,All 42 checks green,Now serving version 2.4", expand:number=-1, cues:string="", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"

number-pop-in.what: Number Pop In. A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal

number-wheel.what: Number Wheel. A rolling digit counter primitive for metrics, prices, counts, and scoreboards

nyc-paris-flight.what: NYC Paris Flight. Apple-style realistic map animation with a plane flying from New York to Paris, marker circle, landing pop, and sound effects.

onboarding-stepper-flow.what: Onboarding Stepper Flow. A composed onboarding flow with milestone rail, active step card, and next-action button

ordered-dither-pass.group: bridge, dither, effects, experiment, motion-primitive, quantize, reveal, texture, transition

oversized-cursor.group: actor, cursor, demonstrate, interaction, motion-primitive, pointer, pointers

overwhelm-surround.what: Overwhelm Surround. Tasks, tabs, pings, and notification bubbles accelerate inward around a calm central subject, turning overload into visible spatial pressure.

page-slide.what: Page Slide. A transitions.dev-inspired page slide primitive with outgoing and incoming panels

pagination.what: Pagination. A tactile pagination row with 40px controls, a recessed current page, and deterministic press feedback

pan-stations.group: agitate, camera, cross-shelved, exhibit, features, pan, stations

panel-reveal.what: Panel Reveal. A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade

parallax-device-dive.group: camera, device, motion-primitive, parallax, phone, transition

particle-image-reveal.group: canvas, deterministic, intros-reveals, motion-primitive, particles, reveal

per-word-crossfade.what: Per-Word Crossfade. Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.

persona-card-fan.what: Four portrait cards deal onto the right side one at a time while displaced cards scale and rotate into a fixed outer wedge that tightens as it fills.

perspective-marquee.what: Perspective Marquee. A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

pricing-tier-focus.what: Pricing Tier Focus. Pricing cards shift focus from free to pro with spotlight emphasis.

progress.what: Progress. An Operator Black progress primitive with a mint active segment and tabular percentage value

progress-steps.what: Progress Steps. A vertical progress sequence with clear complete, current, and waiting states.

push-in.group: camera, emphasize, focus, holdable, motion-primitive, push-in

reddit-post.what: Reddit Post Card. Animated Reddit post card overlay with upvotes and comments

registry.what: Registry. An Operator Black registry list for compact installable-component metadata.

remocn-ui.what: Remocn UI. An Operator Black summary of the UI primitive families available in HyperFrames.

scroll-camera-story.group: camera, demonstrate, parallax, scroll, sections, servo, slot, story
scroll-camera-story.what: Scroll Camera Story. A compressed forced-scroll cinematic pass: a tall scene of slotted sections travels past the camera top to bottom, depth layers parallax at different rates, each section rises as the camera reaches it, and the pass decelerates into a held final section.

scroll-feed.group: agitation, demonstrate, effects, feed, loop, motion-primitive, scroll
scroll-feed.what: Scroll Feed. A loop-friendly column of varied skeleton post cards scrolls upward with subtle motion trails and an agitated pace.

sdf-iris.what: SDF Iris. Shader transition with signed distance field iris reveal

segmentation-flood.group: ai, canvas, demonstrate, deterministic, experiment, hud, motion-primitive, product-demo
segmentation-flood.variables: regions:string="Figure, Signal, Ground", flood_at:number=0.8, flicker:enum="on", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
segmentation-flood.what: Segmentation Flood. Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

select.what: Select. An origin-aware select with a matte menu and explicit selected option

select-item.what: Select Item. A compact option list with selection check, technical hints, and disabled state.

separator.what: Separator. A one-pixel structural separator with horizontal and vertical variants plus a seek-safe progress reveal

settings-toggle-flow.what: Settings Toggle Flow. A composed settings flow with preference rows, toggle switches, and active-state feedback

shader-displacement-panel.what: Shader Displacement Panel. A CSS/WebGL-inspired displacement panel for premium scene reveals without a custom shader dependency.

shared-axis-y.what: Shared Axis Y. Per-word vertical shared-axis transition for sharp editorial swaps.

shared-axis-z.what: Shared Axis Z. Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

sheet.what: Sheet. An Operator Black side sheet with a flat backdrop and right-edge Soft Optical motion

shimmer-sweep.what: Shimmer Sweep. Animated light sweep across text or elements using a CSS gradient mask, ideal for accents and premium reveals

short-slide-down.what: Short Slide Down. New words drop from above and push the stack downward into a locked composition.

short-slide-right.what: Short Slide Right. The phrase glides in from the left while words reveal in sequence.

sidebar.what: Sidebar. A single-plane sidebar with spacious link rhythm, logical-start selection, and soft deterministic entry motion

signup-flow.what: Signup Flow. A composed signup flow with social action, email field, password field, and submit button

simulated-cursor.what: Simulated Cursor. A lightweight cursor pointer and click pulse for product walkthroughs and agent UI demos

skeleton.what: Skeleton. An Operator Black loading skeleton using deterministic solid layers instead of gradient shimmer

skeleton-block.what: Skeleton Block. An Operator Black skeleton block built from deterministic solid loading rows.

skeleton-reveal.what: Skeleton Reveal. A skeleton loader transition that pulses, then cross-fades into content

slider.what: Slider. An accessible slider with semantic progress fill, physical thumb, and value readout

slit-scan-reveal.group: canvas, deterministic, experiment, motion-primitive, reveal, slit-scan, time
slit-scan-reveal.what: Slit Scan Reveal. The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.

slot-machine-roll.what: Slot Machine Roll. A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

soft-blob-touch.group: blob, demonstrate, grain, material, motion-primitive, product-demo, touch
soft-blob-touch.variables: touch_x:number=66, touch_y:number=38, touch_at:number=1.6, grain:enum="fine", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
soft-blob-touch.what: Soft Blob Touch. A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.

soft-blur-in.what: Soft Blur In. A soft opacity, blur, and lift reveal for headlines, captions, and product UI callouts

spain-map.group: choropleth, data, europe, geography, map, spain
spain-map.what: Spain Map. Animated Spain choropleth by autonomous community with staggered reveals and gradient legend, D3 conic conformal projection

spatial-push.what: Spatial Push. A physical depth transition that presses the old scene backward.

spinner.what: Spinner. An Operator Black finite loading spinner with a 1.5px progress ring and status label

split-tilt-cards.group: book-open, compare, holdable, layout, motion-primitive, slots, tilt
split-tilt-cards.variables: label_a:string="Before", label_b:string="After", badge_a:string="v1", badge_b:string="v2", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
split-tilt-cards.what: Split Tilt Cards. Two equal-weight cards arrive from opposite wings with mirrored rotateY book-open tilts under one shared perspective, pill badges spring-pop at each inner edge, and the pair holds with a barely-there phase-opposed idle float. Card bodies are content slots with token skeleton defaults.

spotify-card.what: Spotify Now Playing. Animated Spotify now-playing card with album art and progress bar

spotlight-card.what: Spotlight Card. A card with a scripted cursor spotlight and lit border.

spring-pop.group: effects, motion-primitive, overshoot, pop, reveal, spring
spring-pop.what: Spring Pop. A badge pops in from a visible near-rest scale, overshoots full size once, and settles cleanly.

spring-scale-in.what: Spring Scale In. Words pop in with soft overshoot scale like a physical spring settling.

spring-stack-shuffle.group: demonstrate, interruptible-spring, motion-primitive, physics, product-demo, stack
spring-stack-shuffle.what: Spring Stack Shuffle. A stack of 3 to 5 slotted cards reshuffles on cues: the back card throws over the top and lands at the front with real mass, the rest compress and resettle; cues that land mid-flight redirect the moving cards with velocity preserved.

stagger-cascade.what: Stagger Cascade. A responsive grid of tile cards that fades and travels into place with an evenly spaced per-item GSAP stagger. The ordered cascade is the only visual mechanic.

stagger-lattice.what: Stagger Lattice. A staggered grid reveal inspired by Anime.js v4 stagger utilities, implemented with GSAP for HyperFrames.

staggered-fade-up.what: Staggered Fade Up. Words fade in and slide up one after another with configurable delay.

star-rating-fill.group: data, fill, fractional, prove, rating, stars
star-rating-fill.what: Star Rating Fill. A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.

state-chip-rail.avoid_when: Avoid it when more than eight states or more than four badges are required, because extra states are dropped and badges are capped at four.
state-chip-rail.use_when: A discrete state machine needs seek-exact, instantaneous advances and optional badges beside one activated state.
state-chip-rail.variables: states (string, default "Queued,Reading,Drafting,Done"): comma-separated chip labels in machine order, limited to 2 through 8. times (string, default ""): comma-separated activation times for each advance, with invalid entries replaced, clamped, and forced monotonic. badge_state (number, default 1): state index beside which badges appear, clamped to the state range. badges (string, default ""): comma-separated badge labels, with empty disabling badges and at most four rendered. accent (enum green, blue, or violet, default green): active-chip accent color. exit (enum none, fade, or up, default "none"): departure behavior.
state-chip-rail.what: A row of status chips snaps through ordered states on scheduled cues while active, completed, and pending chips take distinct appearances.

stepper.what: Stepper. A horizontal stepper with numbered milestones, semantic progress, and current-step emphasis

sticky-mock-swap.group: crossfade, demonstrate, feature-tour, mock, motion-primitive, product-demo, sticky
sticky-mock-swap.variables: captions:string="Instant previews,Zero config,Ship on Friday", accent:enum="violet"
sticky-mock-swap.what: Sticky Mock Swap. A pinned product mock cross-fades through accent-tinted feature states while matching captions rise, hold, and exit beside it.

stitched-text-draw.group: craft, deterministic, experiment, motion-primitive, reveal, stitch, text-effects, type
stitched-text-draw.what: Stitched Text Draw. Text drawn as thread stitches: a single-stroke display alphabet draws via attribute-driven dashoffset with stitch-tuned dash patterns, seeded angle jitter, needle-hole dots, a leading needle, and a thread-tail overshoot per letter.

stop-motion-cadence.group: boil, demonstrate, deterministic, experiment, motion-primitive, stepped, stop-motion, time-law
stop-motion-cadence.what: Stop Motion Cadence. The stepped-time law as a demo primitive: one driver quantizes timeline time to floor(t * fps) / fps and feeds ALL motion; four token paper-cut shapes throw-and-land with squash on hits, 2-frame boil jitter seeded per step, and sparkle accents living exactly 2 to 3 frames.

store-badge-lockup.group: ask, cta, mobile, prop, store-badges, ui-props
store-badge-lockup.what: Store Badge Lockup. Settles a short headline above equal-size App Store and Google Play badges as a token-driven mobile end-card call to action.

strikethrough-replace.what: Strikethrough Replace. Draw a strike line across old text, then reveal the replacement.

success-check.what: Success Check. A success check primitive with ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotate blur

svg-line-draw-loader.what: SVG Line Draw Loader. An Anime.js-style path drawing loader implemented as a seekable GSAP stroke timeline.

svg-mask-reveal.group: effect, effects, exhibit, mask, reveal, svg, wordmark
svg-mask-reveal.what: SVG Mask Reveal. A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.

svg-stroke-trace.group: intro, intros-and-reveals, line-draw, motion-primitive, reveal, stroke, svg
svg-stroke-trace.what: SVG Stroke Trace. An authored SVG path draws from its measured length, holds with subtle drift, and optionally fills when the path is closed.

swipe-rail.group: cards, demonstrate, gesture, interaction, motion-primitive, rail, swipe
swipe-rail.what: Swipe Rail. A contact circle leads a horizontal card rail through a fast drag, momentum carry, and settled snap to the next card.

swirl-vortex.what: Swirl Vortex. Shader transition with swirling vortex distortion

switch.what: Switch. A tactile switch with a physical thumb and semantic on/off treatment

table.what: Table. A compact structured-data table with machined row rules, semantic statuses, and tabular time values

tabs.what: Tabs. A minimal tab primitive with an inset mint selection edge, open content hierarchy, and a seek-safe indicator

tabs-slide-indicator.what: Tabs Slide Indicator. A pill indicator transition that slides between active tabs

telemetry-hud.group: demonstrate, deterministic, hud, motion-primitive, product-demo, telemetry
telemetry-hud.variables: readouts:string="fps:59.94,latency:11.8 ms,gpu:38%,heap:1.2 GB", emphasize:number=0, cues:string="", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
telemetry-hud.what: Telemetry HUD. Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

terminal-simulator.what: Terminal Simulator. A terminal window types commands and streams log output.

terminal-to-browser-deploy.what: Terminal to Browser Deploy. Terminal deploy logs hand off into a live browser preview.

testimonial-card.group: prop, prove, quote, social-proof, testimonial, ui-props
testimonial-card.variables: quote:string="This changed how we ship.", author:string="Ken Tanaka", handle:string="@ken", rating:number=5
testimonial-card.what: Testimonial Card. Reveals a customer quote at reading pace, then settles its avatar, author name, and handle beneath as a clean proof beat.

testimonial-proof-card.group: deterministic, motion-primitive, proof, proof-stats, prove, quote, social-proof, testimonial
testimonial-proof-card.variables: quote:string="We shipped our launch video in a single afternoon", name:string="Maya Chen", role:string="Head of Product", company:string="NORTHWIND", emphasis:string="single afternoon", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
testimonial-proof-card.what: Testimonial Proof Card. A quote card whose testimonial reveals per-line through a soft mask, with an avatar disc (initials default, image slot), mono name and role, an optional company text mark, and one emphasis substring underlined in accent ink after the quote lands.

text-shimmer.group: emphasis, emphasize, motion-primitive, shimmer, specular, text-effects
text-shimmer.what: Text Shimmer. A static headline receives one clean specular gradient sweep through its glyphs, then returns to its ordinary text color.

text-stagger.what: Text Stagger. A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words

text-state-swap.what: Text State Swap. A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift

textarea.what: Textarea. A resilient multiline field with a precise focus treatment and readable copy

texture-mask-text.what: Texture Mask Text. CSS luminance masks that cut holes through letterforms - 66 pre-built texture masks from ambientCG PBR color maps

thermal-distortion.what: Thermal Distortion. Shader transition with heat haze thermal distortion

thread-message-stack.avoid_when: Avoid it when frame zero must be empty, because the thread deliberately opens on three settled bubbles.
thread-message-stack.use_when: A conversation must build through alternating incoming and outgoing bubbles while the background continues moving.
thread-message-stack.variables: --tms-roll-bg (color, default not documented): base under the moving blobs and letterbox color for replacement footage. --tms-out-fill (color, default #2D89E1): outgoing bubble fill. --tms-out-ink (color, default not documented): outgoing bubble text color. --tms-in-fill (color, default not documented): incoming bubble fill. --tms-in-ink (color, default not documented): incoming bubble text color. --tms-tag-ink (color, default not documented): sender tag text color. --tms-radius (length, default not documented): bubble corner radius.
thread-message-stack.what: Message bubbles land on the bottom line over a moving background, push older messages upward under a mask, and show a typing pill before each incoming message.

three-orbiting-cards.what: Three Orbiting Cards. A Three.js-powered orbit scene driven by a paused GSAP timeline for deterministic renders.

three-particle-ribbon.what: Three Particle Ribbon. A lightweight Three.js point ribbon with timeline-controlled camera and shader-like color drift.

ticker-takeover.group: headline, motion-primitive, reveal, slot-machine, ticker, typography
ticker-takeover.what: Ticker Takeover. A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.

tiktok-follow.what: TikTok Follow. Animated TikTok follow overlay with profile card and follow button

tilt-card.what: Tilt Card. A transitions.dev-inspired tilt card primitive with depth layers and hover-style parallax

titlecard-calm.what: Titlecard Calm. A restrained title card where a mono kicker and generous grotesque headline fade upward, drift almost imperceptibly, and exit cleanly.

titlecard-lockup.group: breather, lockup, motion-primitive, orient, title-card, typography
titlecard-lockup.variables: wordmark:string="HYPERFRAMES", label:string="WRITE HTML. RENDER VIDEO.", kicker:string="INTRODUCING", rule:enum="show", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
titlecard-lockup.what: Titlecard Lockup. The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.

toast.what: Toast. An Operator Black toast with a semantic success check, progress rail, and stack-origin motion

toggle.what: Toggle. A tactile toggle button with distinct pressed and unpressed states

toggle-flip.group: demonstrate, interaction, prop, reference-prop, toggle, ui-props
toggle-flip.what: Toggle Flip. An oversized UI toggle switch that flips with real physicality: thumb overshoot, track color crossfade, and a soft press-compress before release. The reference prop of the ui-props family.

toggle-group.what: Toggle Group. A segmented toggle group with a recessed sliding selection indicator

tool-menu-slide-in.what: Tool Menu Slide In. A tool menu enters with short-axis slide and icon stagger.

tooltip.what: Tooltip. An Operator Black tooltip with a technical trigger icon and origin-aware Soft Optical reveal

top-down-letters.what: Top-Down Letters. Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

touch-indicator.group: demonstrate, gesture, mobile, motion-primitive, pointer, pointers, touch
touch-indicator.what: Touch Indicator. A translucent contact-circle gesture actor for mobile UI scenes: it touches the glass, causes a same-frame response, and lifts. Tap or swipe, picked by variable.

tracing-beam.group: attention, beam, demonstrate, motion-primitive, path, product-demo, spotlight
tracing-beam.what: Tracing Beam. A glowing dash follows one SVG path through three UI elements, lifting and brightening each element in sequence.

tracking-in.what: Tracking In. A precise letter-spacing reveal for premium headings and interface labels

transitions-3d.what: 3D Transitions. Showcase of 3D perspective flip and rotate transitions

transitions-blur.what: Blur Transitions. Showcase of blur-based transitions between scenes

transitions-cover.what: Cover Transitions. Showcase of cover/uncover slide transitions

transitions-destruction.what: Destruction Transitions. Showcase of destructive break-apart transitions

transitions-dissolve.what: Dissolve Transitions. Showcase of dissolve and fade transitions

transitions-distortion.what: Distortion Transitions. Showcase of warp and distortion transitions

transitions-grid.what: Grid Transitions. Showcase of grid-based tile transitions

transitions-light.what: Light Transitions. Showcase of light-based glow and flash transitions

transitions-mechanical.what: Mechanical Transitions. Showcase of mechanical shutter and iris transitions

transitions-other.what: Other Transitions. Showcase of miscellaneous creative transitions

transitions-push.what: Push Transitions. Showcase of push and slide transitions

transitions-radial.what: Radial Transitions. Showcase of radial wipe and reveal transitions

transitions-scale.what: Scale Transitions. Showcase of scale and zoom transitions

trust-strip.group: logo-strip, motion-primitive, proof, proof-and-stats, prove, trust, wordmarks
trust-strip.variables: marks:string="Northwind, Acme Corp, Globex, Initech, Umbra", tone:enum="muted", cues:string="", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
trust-strip.what: Trust Strip. A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.

type-match-cut.group: bridge, continuity, match-cut, motion-primitive, transition, transitions, typography
type-match-cut.what: Type Match Cut. A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.

typed-prompt.group: demonstrate, deterministic, motion-primitive, product-demo, prompt, typing, ui-props
typed-prompt.variables: text:string="Generate a product launch video", prompt_glyph:string=">", cadence:enum="human", caret:enum="blink", correction:string="", cues:string="", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
typed-prompt.what: Typed Prompt. A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

typewriter.what: Typewriter. Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

ui-3d-reveal.what: 3D UI Reveal. Perspective 3D reveal animation for UI elements

ui-focus-zoom.group: camera, demonstrate, focus, pan, product-demo, servo, slot, zoom
ui-focus-zoom.variables: anchor_x:number=64, anchor_y:number=36, zoom:number=1.6, zoom_at:number=1.4, halo:enum="show", accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
ui-focus-zoom.what: UI Focus Zoom. A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

us-map.what: US Map. Animated US choropleth map with staggered state reveals, value labels, and gradient legend, pure inline SVG with GSAP

us-map-bubble.group: bubble, cities, data, geography, map, usa
us-map-bubble.what: US Bubble Map. Animated US bubble map with proportional city markers, value callouts, and connection lines, composable with us-map

us-map-flow.group: arcs, connections, data, flow, geography, map, usa
us-map-flow.what: US Flow Map. Animated connection arcs between US cities over a base map, composable origin-destination flow visualization

us-map-hex.group: data, geography, hexgrid, map, tilegrid, usa
us-map-hex.what: US Hex Grid Map. Animated hexagonal tile grid map, each state as an equal-weight hex with data fill and abbreviation label

variable-axis-type.what: Variable Axis Type. A locked one-line headline whose weight or width axis morphs into a decisive emphasis beat.

variable-font-flex.group: deterministic, emphasize, experiment, motion-primitive, text-effects, type, variable-font
variable-font-flex.what: Variable Font Flex. A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.

vector-editor-rig.group: app-chrome, bezier, demonstrate, design-tool, pen-tool, prop, ui-props, vector
vector-editor-rig.what: Vector Editor Rig. A dark design-tool app chrome with a live vector pen path, sequential anchor points, bezier handles, a selection frame, and theme-driven blue accents.

velocity-throw-snap.group: exhibit, feature-tour, motion-primitive, physics, rail, snap, throw, velocity
velocity-throw-snap.what: Velocity Throw Snap. A five-shot rail whips past on a fast decaying curve, then overshoots and snaps the selected hero shot exactly to center.

version-plate-type.avoid_when: Avoid it when every word must retain its natural proportions, because resolved words are fitted to one constant ink width and the box separately changes width and height.
version-plate-type.use_when: A word sequence must read as text being manipulated one axis at a time by a visible selection box.
version-plate-type.what: Oversized glyph plates stamp into a cluster, hard-cut to fitted words inside a selection box, then the box widens, shortens, closes on the letters, and pushes off frame.

vfx-iphone-device.what: iPhone & MacBook 3D Showcase. Real GLTF iPhone 15 Pro Max and MacBook Pro models with live HTML-in-Canvas screen content, morphing glass lens, product review camera choreography, and 360° turntable.

vfx-liquid-background.what: Liquid Background. Organic liquid simulation with vertex displacement on a subdivided plane. HTML content floats above rippling fluid surface with real-time wave dynamics.

vfx-text-cursor.what: VFX Text Cursor. Dramatic text reveal with cursor glow, chromatic shadow rays, and directional lighting on a black stage. Canvas-based shader post-processing with spectral color edges.

vignette.what: Vignette. Cinematic radial vignette overlay using a pure-CSS gradient, darkens the edges to pull focus toward the center

vox-annotate.group: annotation, deterministic, emphasize, marker, motion-primitive, text-effects, typography
vox-annotate.variables: text:string="Ship the story, not the spec", keyword:string="story", note:string="the annotate beat", style:enum="highlight", draw_at:number=0.9, accent:enum="green", exit:enum="none"
vox-annotate.what: Vox Annotate. The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

vpn-youtube-spot.what: VPN YouTube Spot. Snappy Apple-style YouTube insert showing a phone finding and installing a friendly VPN app with sound effects.

whip-pan.what: Whip Pan. Shader transition simulating a fast camera whip pan

whip-pan-cut.group: bridge, motion-blur, slots, speed-ramp, transition, transitions, velocity-match, whip-pan
whip-pan-cut.what: Whip Pan Cut. A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

whiteboard-ink.avoid_when: Avoid supplying non-path slot content, because only path elements inside the strokes group become the drawing.
whiteboard-ink.use_when: A preset or caller-supplied SVG sketch needs sequential ink drawing with a traveling pen actor and a caption after completion.
whiteboard-ink.variables: sketch (enum bulb, flow, or rocket, default not documented): preset sketch, ignored when the strokes slot contains paths. caption (string, default not documented): short line shown after drawing completes. pen (enum show or hide, default not documented): traveling nib visibility. accent (enum green, blue, or violet, default not documented): highlight-stroke color. exit (enum none, fade, or up, default "none"): completed-lockup departure behavior.
whiteboard-ink.what: SVG paths draw one stroke at a time while a pen nib follows each active path tip and hops between strokes.

wordmark-tiles.what: Wordmark Tiles. A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

world-map.what: World Map. Animated world choropleth with country-by-country reveal, tooltip labels, and rotating globe inset, D3 Natural Earth projection

x-follow-card.what: X Follow Card. A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.

x-followers-overview.what: X Followers Overview. A social analytics card with count-up and audience pills.

x-post.what: X Post Card. Animated X/Twitter post card overlay with engagement metrics

yt-lower-third.what: YouTube Lower Third. Animated YouTube subscribe lower third with avatar and channel info

z-punch-through.avoid_when: Avoid it when the clip needs a hold, because the documented 2.10-second envelope is filled by the move and has no hold.
z-punch-through.use_when: A scene change must feel like forward travel through an aperture rather than a flat scale zoom.
z-punch-through.variables: front (string, default "BEFORE"): label on the wall. back (string, default "AFTER"): label on the back plane. accent (enum blue, violet, or amber, default blue): light behind the opening.
z-punch-through.what: The camera moves through an opening in a front wall as that wall passes the lens and the back plane advances into its settled state.

zoom-through-transition.what: Zoom Through Transition. A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.
